description: This source file defines the MCPServerManager class responsible for managing MCP (Multi-Cloud Platform) server configurations, including loading server details from configs, handling openapi tool registration, fetching tools/prompts/resources from MCP servers, and orchestrating tool execution with permission and prefix management. It supports various transport types, OAuth metadata discovery, and integrates with external utility modules.

classes.name: MCPServerManager
classes.description: Manages MCP server configurations, including loading from configs, registering OpenAPI tools, retrieving tools/prompts/resources, permission checks, and orchestrating external communication with MCP servers.
